intro.zh: 上「17 測前溫習」之前先做呢 5 題快測，熱身排列與組合：第 1、2 題一按即知對錯；第 3、4 題要揀方法再自己填排列方法數；第 5 題要在表內剔晒所有符合條件的組合，最後按「提交答案」。每題 1 分，共 5 分。
intro.en: Do these 5 quick-check questions before the Chapter 17 pre-test paper. Q1 and Q2 show right or wrong the moment you choose. For Q3 and Q4 choose the method and type the number of arrangements yourself. For Q5 tick every combination in the table that satisfies the condition, then press Submit. 1 mark each, 5 marks in all.

title.zh: 快測 · 5 題（每題 1 分）

stem.en: From a class of 30 students, 3 students are chosen to be the class monitor, the vice monitor and the treasurer. How many ways can this be done?
stem.zh: 從全班 30 位同學中，挑選 3 位同學出任班長、副班長及財政，有多少種選法？

keywords.zh: 三個職位不同 → 次序緊要 → 排列

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 三個職位不同，次序緊要
title.en: Step 1 · Three different posts, so order matters

steps.zh: 班長、副班長、財政是三個「唔同」的職位：甲做班長同乙做班長是兩種不同的選法，所以用排列 $P^{30}_3$，不是組合。
steps.en: Monitor, vice monitor and treasurer are three different posts: swapping two students gives a different selection, so this is a permutation P(30,3), not a combination.

steps.zh: 所以排列方法數是 $P^{30}_3 = 30 \times 29 \times 28 = 24\,360$ 種，答案係選項 B。

traps.zh: $C^{30}_3 = 4060$ 係「無次序」的揀法；但三個職位不同，換位就係另一種選法，所以要用排列。
traps.en: C(30,3) = 4060 ignores the order, but the three posts are different, so a swap gives a different selection.

traps.zh: $30!$ 係把 30 個人全部排一次，多咗大量同題目無關的排列。
traps.en: 30! arranges all 30 students, which counts far more than the question asks.

traps.zh: $3! = 6$ 只係三個人自己之間的排列，漏咗「從 30 人中揀人」嗰一步。
traps.en: 3! = 6 only arranges the three chosen students and forgets to choose them from the 30.

tip.zh: 題目一出現職位（班長、副班長、財政、隊長……），就代表三個人有分別，要用排列 $P$。
tip.en: As soon as the posts are named (monitor, treasurer, captain), the three people are distinguishable, so use a permutation P.

stem.en: From a class of 30 students, 3 students are chosen to form the Mathematics board display team. How many ways can this be done?
stem.zh: 從全班 30 位同學中，挑選 3 位同學組成「數學壁報小組」，有多少種選法？

keywords.zh: 組隊無分次序 → 組合 $C$

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 小組無分次序
title.en: Step 1 · The team has no order

steps.zh: 壁報小組的三個人「無分次序」：甲乙丙同乙丙甲是同一組，所以用組合 $C^{30}_3$。
steps.en: The three members of the team are not ranked: {A, B, C} is the same group as {C, B, A}, so use a combination C(30,3).

steps.zh: 所以組合方法數是 $C^{30}_3 = \frac{30 \times 29 \times 28}{3 \times 2 \times 1} = 4060$ 種，答案係選項 A。

traps.zh: $P^{30}_3 = 24\,360$ 係「有次序」的計法；小組無分職位，換位唔算新組別。
traps.en: P(30,3) = 24 360 counts order; the team has no posts, so swapping the members is not a new group.

traps.zh: $30!$ 把 30 個人全部排一次，遠多於題目所問。
traps.en: 30! arranges all 30 students, far more than the question asks.

traps.zh: $3! = 6$ 只係三個人自己的排列，完全漏咗「從 30 人中揀」嗰一步。
traps.en: 3! = 6 only arranges the three students and misses choosing them from the 30.

tip.zh: 「組成一組／小組／隊伍」無分次序 → 組合 $C$；有職位、有排名、有次序 → 排列 $P$。
tip.en: 'Form a group or team' means order is ignored, so use C; named posts, rankings or order mean P.

stem.en: Five boys and three girls stand in a row for a class photo. Two particular boys must sit together. Which method should be used, and how many arrangements are possible?
stem.zh: 5 位男同學及 3 位女同學排成一列拍班照，其中兩位男同學必須相鄰而坐，應該用哪一種方法？排列方法數是多少？

note.zh: 選 B（綑綁法），排列方法數 10 080

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 判斷用邊種方法

steps.zh: 題目講兩位男同學「必須相鄰」，即兩人要綑埋一齊，所以用綑綁法；插空法是用在「唔可以相鄰」的情況。
steps.en: The two boys must sit together, so tie them into a single block: this is the tie-up method. Slot-in is for people who must not sit together.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 綑成一件再排
title.en: Step 2 · Tie into one block, then arrange

steps.zh: 兩位男同學綑成一件之後，件數是 $3$ 男 $+ 3$ 女 $+ 1$ 件 $= 7$ 件，排一排有 $7!$ 種；框內兩人可以對調，有 $2!$ 種，所以最後要乘返 $2!$。
steps.en: With the two boys tied into one unit there are 3 boys + 3 girls + 1 unit = 7 units, giving 7!; the two inside the block can swap, 2!, so multiply it back.

steps.zh: 所以排列方法數是 $7! \times 2! = 5\,040 \times 2 = 10\,080$ 種，輸入格填 10080。

traps.zh: 插空法用在「唔可以相鄰」；呢題兩位男同學必須相鄰，所以應該用綑綁法。
traps.en: Slot-in is for 'must not sit together'; here the two boys must sit together, so use tie-up.

tip.zh: 「必須／要相鄰」用綑綁法（件數減 1，並乘返框內排列）；「唔可以相鄰」先排其他人再插空（空隙數 = 人數 + 1）。
tip.en: 'Must be adjacent' → tie-up (one fewer unit, multiply back the orders inside); 'must not be adjacent' → seat the others first, then use the gaps (gaps = people + 1).

stem.en: Five boys and three girls stand in a row for a class photo. No two girls may sit together. Which method should be used, and how many arrangements are possible?
stem.zh: 5 位男同學及 3 位女同學排成一列拍班照，所有女同學不能相鄰而坐，應該用哪一種方法？排列方法數是多少？

keywords.zh: 唔可以相鄰 → 插空法

note.zh: 選 A（插空法），排列方法數 14 400

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 判斷用邊種方法

steps.zh: 三個女生唔可以相鄰，所以要把她們分開放，即用插空法：先排好其他人，再把女生插進空隙。
steps.en: The three girls must not sit together, so separate them: use the slot-in method — seat the others first, then drop the girls into the gaps.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 先排男生，數空隙
title.en: Step 2 · Seat the boys, count the gaps

steps.zh: 先排 5 位男同學有 $5!$ 種；5 個人排一排會形成 $5 + 1 = 6$ 個空隙。三位女生要各自坐不同空隙（否則就相鄰），所以是 $P^{6}_{3} = 6 \times 5 \times 4 = 120$ 種。
steps.en: Seat the five boys in 5! ways; five in a row create 5 + 1 = 6 gaps. Each girl needs her own gap, so P(6,3) = 6 × 5 × 4 = 120.

steps.zh: 所以排列方法數是 $5! \times 120 = 120 \times 120 = 14\,400$ 種，輸入格填 14400。

traps.zh: 綑綁法用在「必須相鄰」；呢題三位女生唔可以相鄰，所以應該用插空法。
traps.en: Tie-up is for people who must sit together; here the girls must not sit together, so use slot-in.

tip.zh: $k$ 個人排一排會形成 $k + 1$ 個空隙；插空時每個空隙最多放一人，才可以保證唔相鄰嘅人唔會坐埋一齊。
tip.en: k people in a row create k + 1 gaps; put at most one person in each gap so that nobody who must stay apart sits together.

stem.en: A bag contains 5 red marbles and 4 blue marbles. 3 marbles are drawn from the bag. In the table below, tick every combination of red and blue marbles that satisfies ‘at least 1 red marble’.
stem.zh: 袋中有 5 粒紅波與 4 粒藍波，從中抽出 3 粒波。在下表中，剔出所有符合「至少有 1 粒紅波」的紅、藍組合。

keywords.zh: 「至少 1 粒紅波」＝反面：全部 − 全部藍波

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 先睇清楚邊個組合符合
title.en: Step 1 · Read off the qualifying combinations

steps.zh: 抽 3 粒波而「至少有 1 粒紅波」，即紅波可以是 3、2 或 1 粒；紅波 0 粒（即 3 粒藍波）就唔符合，所以要剔 A、B、C 三行，唔剔 D。
steps.en: With 3 marbles drawn, 'at least 1 red' allows 3, 2 or 1 red; zero red (three blue) does not qualify, so tick rows A, B and C and leave D alone.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 用反面求方法數
title.en: Step 2 · Use the complement for the count

steps.zh: 全部抽法是 $C^{9}_3$；減去「3 粒全部係藍波」嗰組 $C^{4}_3$，就係至少有 1 粒紅波的方法數。
steps.en: All draws are C(9,3); subtract the all-blue draws C(4,3) to leave the draws with at least 1 red.
84 − 4 = 80 ways; case splitting gives C(5,3) + C(5,2)C(4,1) + C(5,1)C(4,2) = 10 + 40 + 30 = 80, the same total.

traps.zh: （0 紅 3 藍）一粒紅波都冇，唔符合「至少有 1 粒紅波」，所以唔應該剔。
traps.en: (0 red, 3 blue) has no red marble at all, so it fails 'at least 1 red' and must not be ticked.

tip.zh: 「至少⋯⋯」用反面最快：全部方法數 − 完全唔合條件嗰組；分類相加時亦要記得 0 嗰個 case 都係有可能。
tip.en: For 'at least ...' use the complement: all ways − the ways that fail the condition. When splitting into cases, remember the zero case can still happen.
